schema.text: Thinking about the income of everyone who lives with you, which of these best describes your household's economic situation?
schema.help: We ask this because the cost of travel affects how people get around.

options.text: We struggle to cover basic needs
We can cover basic needs, but almost nothing is left at the end of the month
We can cover basic needs and manage to save a little
We can afford most things we want with occasional extra expenses
We are financially very comfortable and can easily afford extra expenses

it.#We struggle to cover basic needs: Abbiamo difficoltà a coprire le necessità di base
it.#We can afford most things we want with: Possiamo permetterci la maggior parte delle cose che desideriamo e occasionalmente alcune spese extra
it.#We are financially very comfortable and: Siamo in una situazione economica molto agiata e possiamo permetterci facilmente spese extra
it.#Thinking about the income of everyone w: Pensando al reddito di tutte le persone che vivono con te, quale di queste frasi descrive meglio la situazione economica della tua famiglia?
it.#We ask this because the cost of travel: Lo chiediamo perché il costo degli spostamenti influisce sul modo in cui le persone si muovono.
it.#We can cover basic needs, but almost no: Riusciamo a coprire le necessità di base, ma a fine mese non rimane quasi nulla
it.#We can cover basic needs and manage to: Riusciamo a coprire le necessità di base e a mettere da parte qualcosa

fr.#We struggle to cover basic needs: Nous avons du mal à couvrir nos besoins essentiels
fr.#We can afford most things we want with: Nous pouvons nous permettre la plupart des choses que nous souhaitons, avec quelques dépenses supplémentaires occasionnelles
fr.#We are financially very comfortable and: Nous sommes très à l’aise financièrement et pouvons facilement faire face à des dépenses supplémentaires
fr.#Thinking about the income of everyone w: En pensant aux revenus de toutes les personnes qui vivent avec vous, laquelle de ces phrases décrit le mieux la situation économique de votre foyer ?
fr.#We ask this because the cost of travel: Nous posons cette question parce que le coût des déplacements influence la manière dont les personnes se déplacent.
fr.#We can cover basic needs, but almost no: Nous arrivons à couvrir les besoins essentiels, mais il ne reste presque rien à la fin du mois
fr.#We can cover basic needs and manage to: Nous couvrons les besoins essentiels et arrivons à mettre un peu d’argent de côté

de.#We struggle to cover basic needs: Wir haben Schwierigkeiten, unsere grundlegenden Bedürfnisse zu bezahlen
de.#We can afford most things we want with: Wir können uns die meisten Dinge leisten, die wir möchten, und gelegentliche zusätzliche Ausgaben tragen
de.#We are financially very comfortable and: Wir sind finanziell sehr gut aufgestellt und können zusätzliche Ausgaben problemlos tragen
de.#Thinking about the income of everyone w: Wenn Sie an das Einkommen aller Personen denken, die mit Ihnen leben: Welche Aussage beschreibt die wirtschaftliche Situation Ihres Haushalts am besten?
de.#We ask this because the cost of travel: Wir fragen dies, weil die Kosten der Mobilität beeinflussen, wie Menschen unterwegs sind.
de.#We can cover basic needs, but almost no: Wir können die Grundbedürfnisse decken, aber am Monatsende bleibt fast nichts übrig
de.#We can cover basic needs and manage to: Wir können die Grundbedürfnisse decken und etwas sparen

tr.#We can afford most things we want with: İstediğimiz çoğu şeyi karşılayabiliyoruz ve ara sıra ek harcamalar yapabiliyoruz
tr.#We are financially very comfortable and: Maddi açıdan çok rahatız ve ek harcamaları kolayca karşılayabiliyoruz
tr.#Thinking about the income of everyone w: Sizinle yaşayan herkesin gelirini düşündüğünüzde, hanenizin ekonomik durumunu aşağıdakilerden hangisi en iyi tanımlar?
tr.#We ask this because the cost of travel: Bunu soruyoruz çünkü ulaşım maliyeti insanların nasıl yolculuk ettiğini etkiler.
tr.#We can cover basic needs, but almost no: Temel ihtiyaçlarımızı karşılayabiliyoruz ama ay sonunda neredeyse hiçbir şey kalmıyor
tr.#We can cover basic needs and manage to: Temel ihtiyaçlarımızı karşılayabiliyor ve biraz birikim yapabiliyoruz

fa.#We struggle to cover basic needs: برای تأمین نیازهای اولیه مشکل داریم
fa.#We can afford most things we want with: می‌توانیم بیشتر چیزهایی را که می‌خواهیم تهیه کنیم و گاهی هزینه‌های اضافی هم داشته باشیم
fa.#We are financially very comfortable and: از نظر مالی بسیار راحت هستیم و می‌توانیم هزینه‌های اضافی را به‌راحتی پرداخت کنیم
fa.#Thinking about the income of everyone w: با در نظر گرفتن درآمد همه کسانی که با شما زندگی می‌کنند، کدام گزینه وضعیت اقتصادی خانوار شما را بهتر توصیف می‌کند؟
fa.#We ask this because the cost of travel: این را می‌پرسیم چون هزینه رفت‌وآمد بر نحوه جابه‌جایی افراد اثر می‌گذارد.
fa.#We can cover basic needs, but almost no: می‌توانیم نیازهای اساسی را تأمین کنیم، اما در پایان ماه تقریباً چیزی باقی نمی‌ماند
fa.#We can cover basic needs and manage to: می‌توانیم نیازهای اساسی را تأمین کنیم و کمی هم پس‌انداز کنیم

hu.#We struggle to cover basic needs: Nehézséget okoz az alapvető szükségletek fedezése
hu.#We can afford most things we want with: A legtöbb dolgot megengedhetjük magunknak, és időnként extra kiadásokat is vállalhatunk
hu.#We are financially very comfortable and: Anyagilag nagyon kényelmes helyzetben vagyunk, és az extra kiadásokat is könnyen fedezzük
hu.#Thinking about the income of everyone w: Ha az Önnel együtt élők összes jövedelmére gondol, melyik állítás írja le legjobban a háztartása anyagi helyzetét?
hu.#We ask this because the cost of travel: Azért kérdezzük, mert a közlekedés költségei befolyásolják, hogyan közlekednek az emberek.
hu.#We can cover basic needs, but almost no: Az alapvető szükségleteket fedezni tudjuk, de a hónap végére szinte semmi sem marad
hu.#We can cover basic needs and manage to: Az alapvető szükségleteket fedezni tudjuk, és egy keveset félre is tudunk tenni

ar.#We struggle to cover basic needs: نواجه صعوبة في تغطية الاحتياجات الأساسية
ar.#We can afford most things we want with: يمكننا تحمل تكلفة معظم الأشياء التي نريدها وبعض المصروفات الإضافية أحيانًا
ar.#We are financially very comfortable and: وضعنا المالي مريح جدًا ويمكننا تحمل المصروفات الإضافية بسهولة
ar.#Thinking about the income of everyone w: بالتفكير في دخل جميع من يعيشون معك، أي من هذه العبارات تصف بشكل أفضل الوضع الاقتصادي لأسرتك؟
ar.#We ask this because the cost of travel: نسأل عن ذلك لأن تكلفة التنقل تؤثر في طريقة تنقّل الناس.
ar.#We can cover basic needs, but almost no: نستطيع تغطية الاحتياجات الأساسية، لكن لا يتبقى شيء تقريبًا في نهاية الشهر
ar.#We can cover basic needs and manage to: نستطيع تغطية الاحتياجات الأساسية وادخار القليل
